item.title: Quantum Computers Could Give Scientists a New Way to Explore The Hidden Behavior of Matter
item.summary: Insider Brief PRESS RELEASE — Scientists could have a new way to explore the hidden behaviour of matter, thanks to research involving Queen Mary University of London that uses a quantum computer to carry out a new form of computational spectroscopy.
